subject.title: fix(cli-runner): use sender metadata in CLI session history user labels

question: Should CLI reseed history accept only the three sender fields established by the merged persistence contract, or should `senderLabel` become an approved model-visible identity source?
rationale: The prerequisite deliberately persisted three identity fields without changing prompt content, while this PR introduces a fourth higher-precedence field at a model-visible attribution boundary; code inspection cannot establish that new trust contract.

options.title: Use the existing three-field contract
options.body: Remove `senderLabel` from the renderer and tests, preserving readable fallback through `senderName`, `senderUsername`, then `senderId`.

options.title: Approve senderLabel explicitly
options.body: Define its trusted producer, persistence semantics, precedence, sanitization, and upgrade tests before allowing it to affect model-visible history.

options.title: Pause attribution rendering
options.body: Hold this PR until a broader sender-identity contract is agreed with the related transcript consumers.

recommendation.title: Use the existing three-field contract
recommendation.body: Remove `senderLabel` from the renderer and tests, preserving readable fallback through `senderName`, `senderUsername`, then `senderId`.

likelyOwner.reason: Pick-cat introduced the merged trusted-envelope sender persistence contract that this renderer consumes.
